message.en: A tracking parameter that a chatbot added to a link.
message.zh-TW: 聊天機器人加在連結上的追蹤參數。

hint.en: Delete the parameter from the URL. It means the link was pasted straight from a chat window.
hint.zh-TW: 把參數從網址刪掉。這代表連結是從聊天視窗原樣貼過來的。

pass: Marketing teams track the utm_source parameter in analytics.
He cited [1] and [2] in the footnotes.
Set utm_source=newsletter on every campaign link.

rules.regex: \[(?:Your|Insert|Company|Recipient|Hiring Manager|Client|Customer|Brand|Product)\b[^\]\n]{0,40}\]|【(?:你的|您的|公司|收件人|姓名|日期|插入|此處|在此)[^】\n]{0,20}】

message.en: A template placeholder that nobody filled in.
message.zh-TW: 沒有被填寫的範本佔位符。

hint.en: Replace it with the real name, date or link, or delete the line.
hint.zh-TW: 換成真正的姓名、日期或連結，或整行刪掉。

flag: Our offer ends on [Insert date here].
pass: The note says [sic] after the quote.

message.en: Several **bold** spans in plain text, a habit of chat output that bolds every key phrase.
message.zh-TW: 純文字裡出現多處 **粗體** 標記，是聊天輸出常見的習慣。

hint.en: Keep bold for a real heading or one warning. Drop the stars on ordinary phrases.
hint.zh-TW: 粗體只留給標題或一則警告，一般詞句把星號拿掉。

flag: We offer **fast delivery**, **low prices** and **friendly support** to every customer.
pass: Use ** for multiplication in Python, as in 2 ** 8.

message.en: Lines that start with an emoji, a chat habit for headings and bullets.
message.zh-TW: 以表情符號開頭的行，是聊天輸出用來當標題或項目符號的習慣。

hint.en: Use plain headings and bullets. Keep an emoji only when it carries meaning.
hint.zh-TW: 改用一般標題與項目符號，表情符號只在有意義時才留。
